21933-much-darker-days.description: A book by Andrew Lang. Bear with me if I write like this for ever so many pages; bear with me, it is such easy writing, and only thus can I hope to make you understand my subsequent and slightly peculiar conduct.

arxiv-2005-09592.title: Minimal models of invasion and clonal selection in cancer
arxiv-2005-09592.creator: Chay Paterson
arxiv-2005-09592.description: Abstract One of the defining features of cancer is cell migration: the tendency of malignant cells to become motile and move significant distances through intervening tissue. This is a necessary precondition for metastasis, the ability of cancers to spread, which once underway permits more rapid growth and complicates effective treatment.

arxiv-2103-02666.title: The Anatomy of an Unusual Edge-on Protoplanetary Disk. II. Gas temperature and a warm outer region Facilities: ALMA, JCMT, SOAR, IRTF Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 ) , MCFOST ( Pinte et al. 2006 ; Pinte et al. 2009 ) , Spextools ( Cushing et al. 2004 ) ,
arxiv-2103-02666.creator: Flores C, Duchêne G, Wolff S, Villenave M, Stapelfeldt K, Williams J. P, Pinte C, Padgett D, Connelley M. S, van der Plas G, Ménard F, Perrin M. D
arxiv-2103-02666.description: Abstract We present high-resolution 12 CO and 13 CO 2–1 ALMA observations, as well as optical and near-infrared spectroscopy, of the highly-inclined protoplanetary disk around SSTC2D J163131.2-242627. The spectral type we derive for the source is consistent with a 1.2 ​ M ⊙ \rm 1.2\,M_{\odot} star inferred from the ALMA observations.

arxiv-2107-13372.title: The conjugacy stability problem for parabolic subgroups in Artin groups
arxiv-2107-13372.creator: María Cumplido
arxiv-2107-13372.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by María Cumplido. Given an Artin group A A and a parabolic subgroup P P , we study if every two elements of P P that are conjugate in A A , are also conjugate in P P . We provide an algorithm to solve this decision problem if A A satisfies three properties that are conjectured to be true for every Artin group. This allows to solve the problem for new families of Artin groups.

arxiv-2202-07285.title: Disentangling Domain and Content
arxiv-2202-07285.creator: Dan Andrei Iliescu, Aliaksei Mikhailiuk, Damon Wischik, Rafal Mantiuk
arxiv-2202-07285.description: Abstract Many real-world datasets can be divided into groups according to certain salient features (e.g. grouping images by subject, grouping text by font, etc.). Often, machine learning tasks require that these features be represented separately from those manifesting independently of the grouping. For example, image translation entails changing the style of an image while preserving its content.

arxiv-2211-08990.title: Recovering Galaxy Cluster Convergence from Lensed CMB with Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2211-08990.creator: Liam Parker, Dongwon Han, Pablo Lemos Portela, Shirley Ho
arxiv-2211-08990.description: Abstract We present a new method which leverages conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (cGAN) to reconstruct galaxy cluster convergence, κ \kappa , from lensed CMB temperature maps. Our model is constructed to emphasize structure and high-frequency correctness relative to the Residual U-Net approach presented by Caldeira, et. al. (2019).

arxiv-2301-06529.title: Bright Spatially Coherent Beam from Carbon Nanotube Fiber Field Emission Cathode
arxiv-2301-06529.creator: Taha Y. Posos, Sergey V. Baryshev
arxiv-2301-06529.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Taha Y. Posos, Sergey V. Baryshev. Large area carbon nanotube (CNT) cathodes made from yarns, films or fibers have long been promising as next generation electron sources for high power radio frequency (rf) and microwave vacuum electronic devices. However, experimental evidence have been pointing out spatial incoherence of the electron beam produced by such cathodes that, in turn, impeded the progress toward high brightness CNT electron sources and their practical applications.

arxiv-2304-14448.title: Theory of a Single Magnetic Impurity on a Thin Metal Film in Proximity to a Superconductor
arxiv-2304-14448.creator: Jon Ortuzar, Jose Ignacio Pascual, F. Sebastian Bergeret, Miguel A. Cazalilla
arxiv-2304-14448.description: Abstract We argue that the formation of Yu-Shiba-Rusinov excitations in proximitized thin films is largely mediated by a type of Andreev-bound state named after de Gennes and Saint-James. This is shown by studying an experimentally motivated model and computing the overlap of the wave functions of these two subgap states.

arxiv-2405-03392.title: A note on adjoint reality in simple complex Lie algebras Thanks: ORCID ID: K. Gongopadhyay (0000-0003-4327-0660); C. Maity (0000-0003-0673-3953)
arxiv-2405-03392.creator: Krishnendu Gongopadhyay and Chandan Maity
arxiv-2405-03392.description: Abstract . Let G G be a Lie group with Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} . In [ GM ] , an infinitesimal version of the notion of classical reality, namely adjoint reality, has been introduced. An element X ∈ 𝔤 X\in\mathfrak{g} is adjoint real if − X -X belongs to the adjoint orbit of X X in 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} .

arxiv-2405-15386.title: Exploring Baryon Resonances with Transition Generalized Parton Distributions: Status and Perspectives
arxiv-2405-15386.creator: S. Diehl addr1,addr1a,e5,e4, K. Joo addr1a,e5, K. Semenov-Tian-Shansky addr10,addr10a,e5, C. Weiss addr5,e5, V. Braun addr2, W.C. Chang addr4, P. Chatagnon addr5, M. Constantinou addr6, Y. Guo addr7, P. T. P. Hutauruk addr8, H.S. Jo addr10, A. Kim addr1a, J.-Y. Kim addr5, P. Kroll addr14, S. Kumano
arxiv-2405-15386.description: Abstract QCD gives rise to a rich spectrum of excited baryon states. Understanding their internal structure is important for many areas of nuclear physics, such as nuclear forces, dense matter, and neutrino-nucleus interactions. Generalized parton distributions (GPDs) are an established tool for characterizing the QCD structure of the ground-state nucleon.

arxiv-2412-21183.description: Abstract . A simple abelian variety A A defined over a number field k k is called of GL n \mathrm{GL}_{n} -type if there exists a number field of degree 2 ​ dim ( A ) / n 2\dim(A)/n which is a subalgebra of End 0 ⁡ ( A ) \operatorname{End}^{0}(A) .

arxiv-2502-07804.title: Nuclear Fusion Enhancement by Heavy Nuclear Catalysts
arxiv-2502-07804.creator: Christopher Grayson 1, Johann Rafelski 2
arxiv-2502-07804.description: Abstract We seek to understand the effect of high electron density in the proximity of a heavy nucleus on the fusion reaction rates in a hot plasma phase. We investigate quantitatively the catalytic effect of gold ( Z = 79 Z=79 ) ions embedded in an electron plasma created due to plasmonic focusing of high-intensity short laser pulses.

arxiv-2511-03354.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence in Bioinformatics: A Systematic Review of Models, Applications, and Methodological Advances
arxiv-2511-03354.creator: Riasad Alvi, Sayeem Been Zaman, Wasimul Karim, Arefin Ittesafun Abian, Mohaimenul Azam Khan Raiaan, Saddam Mukta, Md Rafi Ur Rashid, Md Rafiqul Islam, Yakub Sebastian, Sami Azam
arxiv-2511-03354.description: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has become a transformative approach in bioinformatics that often enables advancements in genomics, proteomics, transcriptomics, structural biology, and drug discovery. To systematically identify and evaluate these growing developments, this review proposed six research questions (RQs), according to the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analysis methods.

pmc-11626948.title: Phosphoglycerate mutase 1-mediated dephosphorylation and degradation of Dusp1 disrupt mitochondrial quality control and exacerbate endotoxemia-induced myocardial dysfunction
pmc-11626948.creator: Rongjun Zou, Wanting Shi, Mingxian Chen, Miao Zhang, Dan Wu, Haixia Li, Hao Zhou, Yukun Li, Weihui Lu, Chao Li, Xiaoping Fan
pmc-11626948.description: Rationale: Endotoxemia, caused by lipopolysaccharides, triggers systemic inflammation and myocardial injury by disrupting mitochondrial homeostasis. This study examines the roles of dual specificity phosphatase 1 (Dusp1) and phosphoglycerate mutase family member 1 (Pgam1) in this process.Methods: This study utilized cardiomyocyte-specific Dusp1 knockout (Dusp1Cko) and transgenic (Dusp1Tg) mice, alongside Pgam1 knockout (Pgam1Cko) mice, subjected to LPS-induced endotoxemia.

pmc-11655634.title: Modulating self-assembly and polymorph transitions in bisdendronized squaramides
pmc-11655634.creator: Sergi Bujosa, Llorenç Rubert, Carmen Rotger, Bartolome Soberats
pmc-11655634.description: Supramolecular self-assembly is an advanced approach for constructing ordered nanoscale architectures with broad applications. While the principles of supramolecular polymerization have been thoroughly explored in artificial small molecules, polymer transformations remain barely explored, likely due to the lack of suitable reference models presenting well-defined and reversible transitions between aggregates.

pmc-12430357.title: Gut Microbiome-Derived Short-Chain Fatty Acids in Glomerular Protection and Modulation of Chronic Kidney Disease Progression
pmc-12430357.creator: Maria Szrejder, Agnieszka Piwkowska, Jerome Bellenger
pmc-12430357.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a progressive disorder that is characterized by the gradual loss of kidney function, often leading to end-stage renal failure. Recent research has highlighted the role of gut dysbiosis and its metabolic byproducts in the pathogenesis of CKD, with a particular focus on short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs).

pmc-12732026.title: Gaps in Community-Based Screening for Non-Communicable Diseases in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12732026.creator: Ghadeer Al Ghareeb, Zaenab M. Alkhair, Zainab Alradwan, Hussain Alqaissoom, Horiah Ali Soumel, Khadijah R. Alsaffar, Fatema Muhaimeed, Burair Alsaihati, Mohammad N. Alkhrayef, Ibrahim Alradwan
pmc-12732026.description: Background: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, obesity, and cancer are the leading cause of mortality globally and in Saudi Arabia, accounting for more than 70% of all deaths. Despite national initiatives offering free preventive services, screening uptake remains low.
